title: SMOK Nord GT Empty Replacement Pods - 3 Pack
description: The Smok GT Pod 3-Pack is specially designed for the Smok Nord GT Pod Kit, providing a perfect match for your device. Each pod in this convenient three-pack offers a 2ml e-liquid capacity, ensuring you have enough juice for extended vaping sessions. These pods are designed to deliver a smooth, satisfying vape every time. Whether you’re using your favourite e-liquids or exploring new flavours, these pods make the experience effortless and enjoyable. The pods are easy to fill, thanks to their user-friendly design, and they provide a secure fit with the Nord GT device, ensuring no leaks and optimal performance with Smok’s RPM 3 coils (sold separately.) With the Smok GT Pod 3-Pack, you'll always have a fresh pod at your fingertips, making it easy to switch flavours or replace a pod on the go.
